content_record.title: Ribosome rescue factor Pelota extends lifespan and counters age-related pathology across species
content_record.editorial_body: New research reveals that Pelota, a ribosome-associated quality control factor, promotes longevity by preventing mTOR hyperactivation and preserving autophagy-mediated proteostasis. Pelota is required for longevity in C. elegans. It mitigates senescence, muscle aging, and Alzheimer's neuropathology. Mechanism: prevents mTOR hyperactivation, sustaining autophagy. This signal is based on Pelota-mediated ribosome-associated quality control counteracts aging and age-associated pathologies across species. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
